subject: Momentum & handoff: sprint cadence, output contract, and next steps
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Kim <laura@pulsehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-03 09:12 PDT
Subject: Momentum & handoff: sprint cadence, output contract, and next steps

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for the time today. As promised, I wanted to capture the immediate handoff items so we can keep momentum for the feature enablement sprint (streaming + tool-calls + structured JSON outputs). High level:

- Goal: pilot live streaming + function/tool-calling for patient-summary extraction on a subset of endpoints (10k daily tokens).
- Target cadence: two-week sprints, with a focused M1 (integration + basic output schema) and M2 (tool calling + schema validation).
- Critical decisions needed from PulseHealth by next Thu (2026-10-07): data retention SLA (30/90/365), which endpoints to pilot, and who owns schema signoff.

Attachments: I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (Pulse_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx) and our security QA snapshot (PH_Security_QA.pdf). Please review the MAP and comment on the milestones.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Confirm pilot endpoints and retention choice by Thu 10/07.
2) Schedule 60-min technical onboarding with your engineers — propose Mon 10/05 or Tue 10/06 (times below).
3) Share a representative JSON payload and any schema expectations ahead of the call (we’ll use that for the first integration test).

Available slots (PDT): Mon 10/05 10:00–11:00, 14:00–15:00; Tue 10/06 09:00–10:00, 15:00–16:00.

If you want, we can also arrange a short working session to walk through the streaming/tracing expectations and our structured-output contract.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

[Attachment: Pulse_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 28KB)]
[Attachment: PH_Security_QA.pdf (pdf, 540KB)]
From: Laura Kim <laura@pulsehealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-03 11:03 PDT
Subject: Re: Momentum & handoff: sprint cadence, output contract, and next steps

Thanks Dylan — this is great, appreciate the concise MAP. Quick answers up front:

- Retention: we want 90 days for the pilot, but will confirm with legal for production.
- Pilot endpoints: /patient/summary and /encounter/notes (both read-only).
- Schema ownership: PulseHealth prefers to own the first-pass schema but we want Redwood to provide the gating validation and sample JSONs.

Tom Evans (cc’d) will handle scheduling and procurement@pulsehealth.com will start the NDAs/process for contract redlines.

We can do Mon 10/05 14:00–15:00 PDT for the technical onboarding; please send a calendar invite. Also — on the security QA, can you call out where audit logs will live and if token-level tracing is retained? We need that detail to pass our SOC review.

Thanks,
Laura
Director, Engineering Operations | PulseHealth
laura@pulsehealth.com

Subject: Fwd: Momentum & handoff: sprint cadence, output contract, and next steps

Monica / Soojin —

Looping you in after Laura’s reply. Key asks: 90-day retention for pilot, pilot endpoints (/patient/summary, /encounter/notes), Pulse owns initial schema but wants Redwood validation. They booked Mon 10/05 14:00 PDT for the tech onboarding.

Action items for the internal team before Mon:
- Monica: prepare a short integration checklist (what we'll need from their engineers: sample payloads, auth details, endpoint specs).
- Soojin: confirm tracing/audit log retention options and a short note on token-level tracing policies (we should include locations and retention windows).
- I'll draft the calendar invite and include the MAP + links to the shared drive.

Also want to propose a lightweight acceptance test for M1: given sample payload X, our streaming output must validate against the signed schema and pass the JSON-schema validator with <= 2 schema violations. We'll formalize this in the MAP.

Thanks — planning to finalize internal checklist by EOD.

Dylan

[Forwarded attachments: Pulse_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx, PH_Security_QA.pdf]
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Kim <laura@pulsehealth.com>, Tom Evans <tom.evans@pulsehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@pulsehealth.com
Date: 2026-10-05 16:42 PDT
Subject: Confirmed: Tech onboarding invite + MAP + working artifacts

Laura / Tom —

Thanks — calendar invite is sent for Mon 10/05 14:00–15:00 PDT (Google Meet link included). Monica and Soojin will join for the technical walkthrough. Per Laura’s ask, Soojin attached a short note on tracing/audit logs and retention below.

Soojin Lee (summary):
- Audit & tracing: token-level traces are retained in our internal telemetry store for 90 days by default for dedicated and hosted pilots; we can extend retention behind an enterprise contract.
- Audit logs (request/response hashes, timestamps, model variant used) are stored in the customer audit bucket for 90 days for the pilot and accessible via the Console export API. Full SIEM integrations available via S3 delivery.

Action items closed / next steps:
1) Pulse confirms retention = 90 days (recorded).
2) Pulse confirms endpoints (recorded).
3) Redwood to provide initial schema validator and sample JSONs prior to the call (done — see Drive link).
4) Procurement: we’ll accept a redline; DocuSign link for the MAP is here: https://www.docusign.com/PH-4892-MAP.

Links / artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3PulseHealthOnboard
Attachments: Pulse_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx, PH_Security_QA.pdf

Looking forward to Monday.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
